name: Asset Ownership
summary: Ownership from the ASSET's point of view (Terminus). Three layers — business leaders (Business Owner: groups of assets/apps), technology owners (Owner: routes & paths, from Atlas), and a single complete Asset Owner who owns an asset's every route & path (or 'the rest'). Shows per-asset ownership %, what's unclaimed / blind, crown jewels (ACR >= 9) and what the Hounds already know about them, mitigated/accepted/ignored share, and assigns owners from plain English that reads each asset's tags. All writes gated.
